preconditions.description: The numerator is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The denominator is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == str(numerator // denominator) if numerator % denominator == 0 else (str(numerator // denominator) + '.' + ('(' + repeating_part + ')' if repeating_part else non_repeating_part))
postconditions.description: The return value is the decimal representation of the fraction. If the fraction is an integer, it returns the integer as a string. If there is a repeating part, it encloses the repeating part in parentheses.
